description.value:
Requirements You are adjacent to an enemy that harmed a member of your crop during their last turn or has a member of your crop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Grabbed] or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Restrained].

Sometimes you must dispose of a threat to your crop for good. Strike the required enemy. On a hit, the target takes @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage per weapon damage die. On a critical hit, the target also drops anything they're holding and releases anyone they have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Grabbed] or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Restrained].

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
